name: CMOS OTA-C band-pass/low-pass biquad
description: Two explicit five-MOS transconductors and two 1 nF capacitors form a continuous-time two-integrator loop. A 4.7 kohm damping resistor sets a finite-Q band-pass response at bp, while lp supplies a second-order low-pass output. Ten MOS devices and all passives are shown. DC bias and normalized AC gains at 5, 50 and 500 kHz are checked. This is an active gm-C filter, not a sampled RC or passive LC ladder. Finite output resistance affects the ideal transfer; Q accuracy, tuning range, noise, linear swing and PVT are not qualified.
